thread:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing private deploy alpha gating. We need crisp launch criteria for customer-managed networking (BGP/NAT). Short list: preserve announced prefixes, deterministic egress, rollback SLA, and install presets for field.
ash: For clarity, MVP = per-cluster static egress + BGP passive peer. Per-tenant egress later.
rowan: Suggest an "onramp manifest" (compact JSON + one-page runbook) to attach to SOWs so field has a machine-readable checklist. Example snippet: {"preset":"keep-egress","customer_steps":["announce-prefix","provide-bgp-peer","open-icmp"]}
lee: Security: airgap builds must include a signed manifest and offline KMS import steps. Also require a cert-rotation test and telemetry allowlist table.
maya: Upgrade flow idea: canary ns -> deploy operator vNext -> smoke tests (bgp session, egress-ip match, KV warm) -> staged rollout -> fast revert <20m. Include explicit egress-stability check (curl --interface).
infra-bot: CI alert: private-onramp/e2e bgp-handoff flaky (timeout). https://ci.internal/issue/9992 :warning:
ash: I'll take CI triage and vendor config diff. ETA EOD.
rowan: Action owners: ash (CI + bgp fix), lee (security gating + KMS tests), maya (manifest + installer presets), rowan (rollback playbook + rollback drill).
maya: GO/NO-GO proposal: GO if all gates pass in two distinct customer sandboxes AND at least one successful rollback drill. NO-GO otherwise. Any objections?
ash: none.
lee: none.
infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled network sweep 07:00 UTC tomorrow.
maya: Thanks — I'll update the spec and post link to the drive.
